text:
**APPROVE.** The foundation stillness fix and the GUI button guard hold together with the save flag, portrait motion, and music controller. I did not execute Lua, the HTML5 build, or the browser scenarios, and the PNG/OGG bytes were not in the source, so pixel and PCM claims stay outside this signoff.

### Foundation stillness

`base_slot.script` now posts `index_layout {compact=false, exposed=false}` at the start of `occupy_slot`, before the per-card z capture. That covers a manual drop, an animated auto-move, and a restore, which only goes through `occupy_slot`.

`card.script` applies `self.exposed = message.exposed ~= false` before the atlas swap. `dragon_eligible` requires `self.exposed`, a non-compact index, and `not self.collected`. The same `index_layout` path stops `dragon_motion` and sets `#portrait` alpha to 0.

`drop_success` does set `self.exposed = true` and `self.collected = (message.complete == true)`. Foundation arrivals do not use `complete` (that flag is the dragon path). Ordering still ends at `exposed=false`: `occupy_slot` posts `index_layout` while it runs, so that message is queued after a `drop_success` posted in the same burst, whichever of the two was posted first. The slot callback only stores the captured `landed` position; it does not post another `drop_success`. Restored cards never take the `drop_success` path.

`solver/tests/test_dragon_motion.lua` loads the real `card.script` and `base_slot.script`, delivers the slot’s posted messages, and fails if any later `play_animation` appears. The red/green logs were not re-run here; the test as written fails if `exposed` stays true.

### Buttons

`button.lua` animates only the `_face` child, so the hit node stays full size. Press consumes and does not activate. Release outside, a screen change, `button.cancel`, or a disabled node does not activate. `pose` hits `id .. "_face"`, which every control from `button()` in `tools/build-theme.py` has.

`gui/ui.gui_script` `on_input` returns true when `button.input` consumes the gesture, and again for the start screen and the victory overlay. A HUD press therefore does not reach the cursor. Disabled rail buttons are omitted by `gui.is_enabled`, so the press falls through during a game. `solver/tests/test_layout.lua` calls this real `on_input` for press, cancelled release, and the disabled case. Removing that `return true` makes the press assertion fail. Action still runs only from `activate` on release, with `preserve_save` unchanged.

### Save and resume

`restart_level(true)` is sent for the rail TUTORIAL button, SKIP, and PLAY NOW after a tutorial win. RESTART and PLAY AGAIN call `restart_level()` with no argument. `preserve_save == true` is strict, so a missing flag still clears.

`game_manager.script` clears only when `message.preserve_save` is absent. `start_game` still does not clear. Skip and PLAY NOW clear `tutorial_state.is_tutorial` before the preserving restart, so the reloaded `main.script` takes the existing non-tutorial branch and reads the file. Menu TUTORIAL sets the tutorial flag and then `start_game`, so entry does not wipe the file. `solver/tests/test_effects_review.lua` checks those real GUI paths.

### Motion, indices, music

Buried cards go compact only when the column pitch is under 32 px; the top card stays on the large face. `index_layout` is what swaps `sprite_id` / `_compact`. Held motion waits 0.7–3 s, then 2–6 s, on the module PRNG in `dragon_motion.lua` (`math.random` is not used). Drop, cover, compact, and `exposed=false` all stop the cycle. Animals play `#portrait` over the `_empty` face; dragons swap full-card frames. `cursor.script` hover posts `dragon_hover` only when the id changes; `free_cell.script` forwards that to the parked card.

`music.script` plays `#ambient` once, fades, pauses at gain 0, and resumes the same voice. Level reload does not create another one because `music.go` is in the root collection. The audio pref is a separate `audio` save. `celebration.lua` and `menu_motion.lua` do not touch the deal RNG.

`sprite.max_count = 256` covers 40 cards × 5 sprites (face, portrait, shadow, outline, hint) plus the slot sprites.

### Residual notes

- `INDEX.md` still says **279/279** after the new suites were added to `solver/tests/run_all.lua`.
- `tools/build-theme.py` tries to rewrite the skip button’s `ui/outlined` texture. `button()` already emits `ui/button_hit` and `inherit_alpha: false`. The committed `gui/ui.gui` skip node is already correct.
- `music.go` sets component gain `0.28`. `music.script` ramps the playing voice to `1`. The OGG is normalized in `tools/compose-garden.py` to a peak near −8 dBFS.
- `cursor.script` `fly_card_arc` clamps the apex to y=459 while the top row sits at y=457, so that flight is nearly flat. `architecture.md` already says so.
- `tools/browser-review.py` defaults to one browser and also accepts `--jobs 2`.

Jade decks, unreferenced emblems, and review screenshots are not what `main/main.atlas` loads. The live theme is vivid: `main/Scripts/theme.lua` has `wildlife=false` and `compact_indices=true`.
